name: @kakushi/cre
description: Kakushi's Chainlink CRE workflows: kakushi-attest-<chain> (one per chain: Monad, Sepolia, Base Sepolia, Arbitrum Sepolia, OP Sepolia; cron: commit every source payment and Maker payout of a block window as a sorted Poseidon2 root on the Monad hub) and kakushi-source-native (HTTP: attest one native transfer). Plus the local runner that executes the same logic through the simulation forwarder.

scripts.build: for w in attest-monad attest-sepolia attest-base attest-arbitrum attest-op source-native; do cre workflow build ./workflows/$w || exit 1; done
